label: Standard deviation as a distance
subgoals: Read the mean from the data
Square each distance from the mean
Take the square root of the average squared distance

label: Computing population and sample spread
subgoals: Divide by N for a population
Divide by n-1 for a sample
Keep the answer in the data's units

label: Comparing distributions
subgoals: Compare spread only in comparable units
Use standard deviation to describe typical distance
